verdict.rationale: Monitoring API traffic is a fair question for an API client, since such tools can ship monitors and observability integrations. Bruno's evidence shows no metrics, logging, or tracing integrations for API traffic. The CLI test reports (JSON/JUnit/HTML) are an adjacent test-result feature, not traffic monitoring, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor API traffic with metrics, logging, and tracing integrations
